answer: The strongest sybil defense is slashing: every verifier posts a stake, and if it countersigns a transaction that later proves forged or invalid, the protocol burns its bond on-ledger. Attackers must echo the same forged block across enough honest verifiers that some get caught, and each caught signature costs more than a whole epoch of rewards. Identity becomes sable-costly: fake nodes are cheap to create but ruinous to keep, so sybils starve while honest consensus compounds trust.
